CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ask_answer(p_slug text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  with a as (select * from pinnacle_answer where slug = p_slug and status='published' limit 1),
  q as (select * from pinnacle_question where answer_id=(select id from a) limit 1)
  select case when (select id from a) is null then null else jsonb_build_object(
    'slug', a.slug,
    'url',  'https://pinnacleblooms.org/ask/'||a.slug,
    'svg',  'https://pinnacleblooms.org/ask/'||a.slug||'.svg',
    'canonical','https://pinnacleblooms.org/ask/'||a.slug,
    'lang', a.lang, 'persona', a.persona,
    'title', a.title, 'h1', coalesce(a.h1,a.title),
    'question', a.question, 'summary', a.summary, 'answer_md', a.answer_md,
    'what_to_watch', a.what_to_watch, 'everyday_tip', a.everyday_tip,
    'faq', coalesce(a.faq,'[]'::jsonb),
    'route', a.route, 'primary_domain', a.primary_domain, 'primary_index', a.primary_index,
    'schema_type', a.schema_type,
    'meta_title', a.meta_title, 'meta_description', a.meta_description,
    'meta_robots', case
        when not public.ask_indexing_enabled() then 'noindex, nofollow'
        when q.editorial_status='published' then 'index, follow, max-image-preview:large, max-snippet:-1, max-video-preview:-1'
        else 'noindex, follow' end,
    'index_state', case
        when not public.ask_indexing_enabled() then 'hold'
        when q.editorial_status='published' then 'indexable' else 'in_review' end,
    'breadcrumb', coalesce(a.breadcrumb,'[]'::jsonb),
    'jsonld', a.jsonld,
    'share', coalesce(a.share,'{}'::jsonb),
    'authority_links', coalesce(a.authority_links,'[]'::jsonb),
    'related', coalesce(a.related,'[]'::jsonb),
    'also_asked', coalesce(a.also_asked,'[]'::jsonb),
    'og_title', a.og_title, 'og_subtitle', a.og_subtitle, 'og_category', a.og_category,
    'hreflang_group', a.hreflang_group,
    'published_at', a.published_at, 'last_reviewed_at', a.last_reviewed_at,
    'entity', jsonb_build_object('kind',q.entity_kind,'key',q.entity_key,'slug',q.entity_slug,'name',q.entity_name),
    'parent', jsonb_build_object(
        'category', case when q.entity_slug is not null
                         then jsonb_build_object('label',q.entity_name,'url','/ask/'||q.entity_slug) else null end,
        'dimension', (select jsonb_build_object('key',ad.key,'label',ad.label,'url','/ask/'||ad.key)
                      from ask_dimension ad where q.entity_kind = any(ad.source_keys) limit 1)),
    'about_code', q.about_code, 'about_system', q.about_system,
    'age_band', q.age_band_key, 'intent', q.intent, 'lifecycle_step', q.lifecycle_step,
    'speakable', coalesce(q.speakable,false),
    'eeat', jsonb_build_object(
        'developed_by', q.developed_by, 'reviewed_by_bench', q.reviewed_by_bench,
        'reviewed_by_seat', q.reviewed_by_seat, 'reviewed_at', q.reviewed_at,
        'editorial_status', q.editorial_status, 'content_grade', q.content_grade,
        'evidence_level', q.evidence_level, 'review_cadence_days', q.review_cadence_days)
  ) || jsonb_build_object(
    'entity_kind', a.entity_kind,
    'entity_key',  a.entity_key,
    'about_codes', coalesce(a.about_codes,'[]'::jsonb),
    'age_min_months', a.age_min_months,
    'age_max_months', a.age_max_months,
    'lead_cta', a.lead_cta,
    'related_techniques', coalesce(a.related_techniques,'[]'::jsonb),
    'related_materials',  coalesce(a.related_materials,'[]'::jsonb),
    'i18n', jsonb_build_object(
        'lang', a.lang,
        'alternates', coalesce((
            select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
                     'lang', x.lang,
                     'href', 'https://pinnacleblooms.org/ask/'||x.slug,
                     'index_state', case when x.lang='en' then 'indexable' else 'in_review' end
                   ) order by (x.lang<>'en'), x.lang)
            from pinnacle_answer x
            where x.status='published'
              and x.slug in (
                case when a.lang='te' then regexp_replace(a.slug,'-te$','') else a.slug end,
                (case when a.lang='te' then regexp_replace(a.slug,'-te$','') else a.slug end)||'-te'
              )
        ), '[]'::jsonb),
        'x_default', 'https://pinnacleblooms.org/ask/'||(case when a.lang='te' then regexp_replace(a.slug,'-te$','') else a.slug end)
    )
  ) end
  from a left join q on true;
$function$
category_rpc:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.ask_category(p_kind text, p_value text, p_k integer DEFAULT 200)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
declare
  v_kind text := lower(trim(coalesce(p_kind,'')));
  v_val  text := trim(coalesce(p_value,''));
  v_label text; v_slug text; v_total int;
  v_groups jsonb; v_coded jsonb; v_dim jsonb; v_prov jsonb;
  v_idx_on boolean := public.ask_indexing_enabled();
begin
  if v_kind='' or v_val='' then return jsonb_build_object('error','kind and value required'); end if;

  select max(q.entity_name), max(coalesce(q.entity_slug,v_val)), count(*)::int
    into v_label, v_slug, v_total
  from pinnacle_question q
  join pinnacle_answer a on a.id=q.answer_id and a.status='published'
  where q.entity_kind=v_kind and (q.entity_key=v_val or q.entity_slug=v_val);

  select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('key',g_key,'label',g_label,'sort',g_sort,'count',g_count,'items',items) order by g_sort)
    into v_groups
  from (
    select coalesce(c.cluster_key,'more') g_key,
           coalesce(c.cluster_label,'More questions') g_label,
           coalesce(min(c.cluster_sort),99) g_sort,
           count(*)::int g_count,
           jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('q',coalesce(a.title,q.question_text),'slug',a.slug,
                     'url','/ask/'||a.slug,'intent',q.intent)
                     order by coalesce(q.value_score,0) desc, a.title) items
    from pinnacle_question q
    join pinnacle_answer a on a.id=q.answer_id and a.status='published'
    left join ask_intent_cluster c on c.intent=q.intent
    where q.entity_kind=v_kind and (q.entity_key=v_val or q.entity_slug=v_val)
    group by coalesce(c.cluster_key,'more'), coalesce(c.cluster_label,'More questions')
  ) g;

  select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('system',system,'code',code,'display',display,'who_uri',who_uri,'verified',verified)
                   order by case system when 'ICD-11-MMS' then 1 when 'ICD11' then 2 when 'ICF' then 3
                                        when 'ICFFUNC' then 4 when 'SNOMEDCT' then 5 else 9 end)
    into v_coded
  from pinnacle_standard_code sc
  where sc.entity_type=v_kind and sc.entity_key in (v_val, v_slug) and coalesce(sc.map_role,'')<>'deprecated';

  select jsonb_build_object('key',ad.key,'label',ad.label,'chamber',ad.chamber,'url','/ask/'||ad.key)
    into v_dim from ask_dimension ad where v_kind = any(ad.source_keys) limit 1;

  select jsonb_build_object(
    'reviewed_by', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(distinct q2.reviewed_by_bench)
        from pinnacle_question q2 join pinnacle_answer a2 on a2.id=q2.answer_id and a2.status='published'
        where q2.entity_kind=v_kind and (q2.entity_key=v_val or q2.entity_slug=v_val) and q2.reviewed_by_bench is not null),'[]'::jsonb),
    'last_reviewed_at', (select max(a3.last_reviewed_at)
        from pinnacle_question q3 join pinnacle_answer a3 on a3.id=q3.answer_id
        where q3.entity_kind=v_kind and (q3.entity_key=v_val or q3.entity_slug=v_val))
  ) into v_prov;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'kind', v_kind, 'value', v_val,
    'label', coalesce(v_label, initcap(replace(v_val,'-',' '))),
    'slug', v_slug, 'canonical_path', '/ask/'||v_slug,
    'dimension', v_dim,
    'count', coalesce(v_total,0),
    'indexable', (coalesce(v_total,0) >= 8 and v_idx_on),
    'index_state', case when not v_idx_on then 'hold'
                        when coalesce(v_total,0) < 8 then 'below_threshold' else 'indexable' end,
    'coded_identity', coalesce(v_coded,'[]'::jsonb),
    'provenance', v_prov,
    'groups', coalesce(v_groups,'[]'::jsonb)
  );
end $function$
